strengths: One clear promise and dominant button above the fold

personas.goal: judge credibility and book the teardown (desktop head of growth)
personas.outcome: reached the calendar, would book but hesitated on proof and price

personas.goal: book the teardown on mobile (DTC founder)
personas.outcome: reached the calendar in one tap, did not book

findings.title: Case studies end with no way to book
findings.problem: The inne, Eduki and trivago case studies have no teardown button; the only link on is 'Back to Home'.
findings.why_it_costs_sales: A reader who has just seen the strongest proof has no next step and may leave.
findings.fix: Add the home header and button, a button after the summary, and a closing CTA block.

findings.title: Contact page has no booking path
findings.problem: Contact lists email, WhatsApp, Upwork and an address with equal weight and no booking link or form.
findings.evidence: pages/contact/elements.json forms: []; copy: 'use one of the contact methods above'
findings.why_it_costs_sales: Visitors who go to Contact to take the next step must write an email instead of booking in one click.
findings.fix: Make the H1 'Book your free 20 minute teardown' with the cal.com button first.

findings.title: The booking click is not measured
findings.problem: Only Cloudflare page views are recorded; no click or booking event is visible for the cal.com CTA.
findings.evidence: tracking.json events {}; no click handler in pages/home/page.html
findings.why_it_costs_sales: Without a click count you cannot tell which page or source produces teardown requests.
findings.fix: Add a cta_click event to every cal.com link and connect bookings to analytics.

findings.title: Only one of five case-study tests reports a result
findings.problem: Test 1 has numbers but no sample size, runtime or significance; Tests 2-5 give hypotheses only.
findings.why_it_costs_sales: A skeptical buyer asks about the other results and the claim '100+ tests' rests on one winner.
findings.fix: Add sample size and runtime for Test 1; publish outcomes or mark Tests 2-5 'not published'.

findings.title: The teardown is not explained next to the button
findings.problem: Hero and closing CTA say only 'Get your free 20 minute teardown'; the no-obligation explanation is on cal.com after the click.
findings.why_it_costs_sales: 'Teardown' is jargon; a visitor unsure what they get may not click.
findings.fix: Add one line under each button saying what the call is and what to bring.

findings.title: Proof rests on one testimonial and text-only client names
findings.problem: One testimonial (Truely/IDA CEO, no numbers); vetsak and Teeth Lovers are plain text.
findings.evidence: pages/home/page.html What Clients Say, Selected Clients
findings.why_it_costs_sales: A skeptical buyer sees little third-party validation next to the booking button.
findings.fix: Add 2-3 testimonials with a number and client logos.

findings.title: The page does not say who the offer is for
findings.problem: No mention of ecommerce, DTC or online stores; inne and Eduki are named but unexplained.
findings.why_it_costs_sales: Visitors cannot tell if the service fits their business.
findings.fix: Add a 'for ...' line and a few words per client.

findings.title: Services show no price signal
findings.problem: Services list no price, range or starting point.
findings.why_it_costs_sales: Buyers cannot judge affordability before booking.
findings.fix: Add a 'from' price or 'priced by traffic'.

findings.title: Inner pages use an older template with low-contrast accents
findings.problem: Case study and contact have no nav or teardown button; amber #F59E0B on white is 2.15:1, purple labels 3.96:1.
findings.why_it_costs_sales: The pages feel like a different, older site and the accent text is hard to read.
findings.fix: Reuse the home header and theme; use an accent with 4.5:1 contrast for text.

findings.title: No CTA follows the reader on mobile
findings.problem: Header teardown button is behind the hamburger; the hero and closing buttons are the only entries.
findings.why_it_costs_sales: A reader who scrolls past the hero must scroll back to book.
findings.fix: Add a slim sticky button after the hero.

findings.title: Booking page opens in a new tab with an empty timezone
findings.problem: Timezone selector shows 'Select...'; link has target=_blank.
findings.why_it_costs_sales: Extra step before slots make sense.
findings.fix: Open in the same tab or prefill the timezone.

findings.title: A/B testing SDK loaded with no test configured
findings.problem: Endless Testing loads on home and contact; no test ID unless passed in the URL.
findings.why_it_costs_sales: Extra script with no purpose; site cannot run a test anyway on the assumed baseline.
findings.fix: Remove it or finish the setup once the baseline is confirmed.

findings.title: Truely card links to Upwork, not a case study
findings.problem: The Truely & IDA card goes to the Upwork profile; other cards go to on-site case studies.
findings.fix: Link to an on-site page or label it clearly.

findings.title: Gmail address and no photo of Valentin on the home page
findings.problem: Business email is Gmail; About goes to the CV page; no photo on home.
findings.why_it_costs_sales: Slightly weaker credibility for a consultant selling to CEOs.
findings.fix: Use a domain email, add a photo, make About a real page.

findings.title: Footer year is 2025 on inner pages
findings.problem: Case study and contact say © 2025; home says 2026.

findings.title: Small links and a blank band on mobile
findings.problem: 'See the results', Email and WhatsApp are small text links; an empty band appeared under the header in one scroll capture.
findings.why_it_costs_sales: Hard to tap; the band may look like missing content.
findings.fix: 44px tap targets; re-check on a real phone.

findings.title: Case study is text only
findings.fix: Add test screenshots if the client allows.

issues: No click or booking event on cal.com links
A/B SDK loaded with no test ID
access_requests: Cloudflare Web Analytics viewer or API token
cal.com booking export / monthly lead count for last 3 months
